response.original_title: [Complete-Guide] How do I Add A passenger to my Norwegian Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) reservation +1-866-254-7549, you cannot do it online or through the mobile app; you must call NCL customer service directly at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or contact your original travel agent to process the change. Requirements and Process Capacity Check: The addition depends on whether your stateroom has physical capacity (such as a 3rd or 4th pull-down or pull-out bed) +1-866-254-7549 and whether the specific zone of the ship has open lifeboat and total passenger capacity +1-866-254-7549. Information Needed: Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and loyalty/past-guest numbers ready when you call +1-866-254-7549. Pricing & Fees: The reservation will be repriced at current prevailing fare rates, and you will need to pay the additional cruise fare, government taxes, port charges, and daily service charges/gratuities +1-866-254-7549.
